cover_headline: A. R. Rahman Spent Three Years on 'Ramayana' Music, Turned Down 10–12 Films

end.headline: A. R. Rahman Spent Three Years on 'Ramayana' Music, Turned Down 10–12 Films
end.line: Rahman told a press conference at IFFI in Panaji that he set aside almost everything else for Nitesh Tiwari's two-part epic, co-composing with Hans Zimmer.

facts: Rahman has spent nearly three years on the music of Nitesh Tiwari's two-part 'Ramayana' and turned down 10–12 film projects to stay focused on it
He is composing the score with Hans Zimmer, and some pieces went through 12–13 versions, including the 'Ravana Tandav'
The Hindi-language epic stars Ranbir Kapoor as Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana; its first part reached cinemas at Diwali 2026

quote.role: Oscar-winning composer, speaking at IFFI in Panaji
quote.speaker: A. R. Rahman
quote.text: We've been doing 'Ramayana' music for three years, the themes and everything. And some of them have like, 12–13 versions.
